description.en: Wallpaper theming for DeepSeek Harness: bundled 4K photo, your own image or video, paper-anchored palettes, translucency, custom logo, quick chips and named themes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换壁纸与配色：内置 4K 照片、自己的图片或视频、纸面锚点配色、透光、自定义图标、快捷条与命名主题。

description.en: Fresh white-green theme with photo/video wallpapers, one-click presets, wallpaper-derived or custom palettes, translucent sidebar and bubbles, brand colours, custom logo, quick chips and named themes you can export.
description.zh: 清新白绿皮肤：图片/视频壁纸、一键预设、壁纸取色或自定义配色、侧栏与气泡透光、品牌色与自定义图标、快捷条，主题可保存与导出。
